summary_1line: Duryodhana recounts the immense tributes and exotic gifts brought by kings and tribes to Yudhishthira, fueling his envy of the Pandavas’ overwhelming wealth.

image_candidates.scene_text: At Yudhishthira’s palace gate, long lines of foreign kings and strange tribes wait with elephants, horses, gold, and jeweled swords as guards deny them entry.
Bhagadatta of Pragjyotisha stands amid Yavana warriors, presenting ivory‑handled swords studded with gems before turning away from the crowded gate.
Delegations from distant lands display vivid horses—red like cochineal, rainbow‑hued, and cloud‑colored—beside piles of gold and exotic textiles.
